title: Repair FT-006 response path redaction and cursor canonicality
verify: PostgreSQL-backed service and HTTP tests prove recursive best-effort handling across direct card/list fields, nested values, and mapping keys for obvious standalone or clearly bounded POSIX, Windows-drive, UNC, and file-URI paths.

Redaction tests include Plant display_name and path-shaped JSON keys while proving complete valid non-file URLs, delimiter-free URL-first ambiguous values, and safe relative artifact refs remain usable.

Cursor tests prove the service-emitted canonical cursor continues correctly and every non-alphabet, whitespace, padding, wrong-version, extra/missing-field, invalid-timestamp, invalid-source-type, invalid-UUID, or non-canonical form returns HISTORY_CURSOR_INVALID.
Authenticated HTTP tests prove malformed cursors return 422 with the stable error envelope and no history success payload.
Existing PostgreSQL authority, retained-history authorization, timeline no-replay, ordering, filtering, and no-store tests remain green.
An independent Reviewer runs /verify and task-level /red-verify before feature-level /red-verify --feature FT-006 is repeated.

FT-006 focused and full regression summaries
purpose: Restore the clarified FT-006 URL-first best-effort local-path presentation and strict-query contracts without an exhaustive URL/path parser arms race.
success_outcome: FT-006 recursively best-effort redacts obvious standalone or clearly bounded POSIX, drive, UNC, and file-URI paths; preserves complete valid non-file URLs and safe relative refs; removes retry 01-07 URL candidate grammar/state-machine machinery and generated delimiter/candidate tests used only for rejected exhaustive semantics; and allows only canonical service-emitted cursors to produce 200 history pages.
anti_goals: No upstream Plant display-name validation or Plant-management contract change.
No PostgreSQL schema, history source family, ordering, or retained-history authorization change.
No raw export, PWA, Vision, agent, Safety Gate, task/follow-up, Companion, or dataset implementation.
No rewrite of historical TASK-023 or TASK-024 lifecycle/evidence.
No exhaustive URL/path grammar, parser state machine, finite delimiter catalogue, generated candidate matrix, or replacement arms race.
Do not retain retry 01-07 parser/test complexity solely to satisfy superseded exhaustive redaction semantics.

forbidden_scope: new history source families, persistent history tables, or event sourcing
raw export, PWA, Vision, agent, Safety Gate, task, Companion, or dataset behavior
exhaustive URL/path parser grammar, state machine, delimiter catalogue, or generated candidate arms race
stop_conditions: The response-wide policy cannot preserve canonical safe relative artifact refs.
The repair requires changing upstream Plant-management public input behavior.
Cursor strictness requires changing the documented history sort tuple or pagination response shape.
The repair weakens ActorContext or archived retained-history authorization.
The implementation retains or adds retry-era URL candidate/delimiter machinery solely to pursue exhaustive path-vs-URL discrimination instead of simplifying it.
Diagnostics or evidence contain credentials, auth material, raw SQL errors, provider payloads, hidden reasoning, raw chat, or unapproved governance content.

constraints: Apply one recursive best-effort local-path policy to direct/nested response strings and mapping keys, including Plant display_name.
Redact a recognized obvious local-path string value as a whole, omit an entry whose key is recognized as an obvious local path, and preserve safe relative artifact refs.
Cover grounded obvious standalone or clearly bounded POSIX, Windows-drive, UNC, and file-URI forms without claiming exhaustive discrimination.

Treat a complete valid non-file URL as one exempt value/span including path, query, fragment, and path-like substrings; delimiter-free ambiguous content that parses as that URL is URL-first and preserved.
Remove retry 01-07 URL candidate grammar/state-machine helpers and generated delimiter/candidate tests used only for superseded exhaustive semantics; do not replace them with another complex parser.
Accept only unpadded base64url cursor input whose exact v1 JSON shape and decode/re-encode identity match the service encoder; all other forms return HISTORY_CURSOR_INVALID.
invariants: Obvious standalone or clearly bounded local paths are best-effort redaction targets throughout the serialized response graph; ambiguous completeness is not a hard privacy/security guarantee.
Mapping keys use the same minimal recursive policy as values; recognized obvious path keys do not survive serialization.
Complete valid non-file URLs and delimiter-free content parsed as such URLs remain visible under the URL-first rule.
Only canonical service-emitted cursors can continue pagination; permissive decoder behavior never changes HTTP success.
PostgreSQL/read model remains history authority and retained reads grant no operational authority.
verification_targets: Run focused public card/list recursion probes for obvious standalone/clearly bounded POSIX, drive, UNC, and file-URI paths plus complete valid non-file URLs, delimiter-free URL-first ambiguity, and safe relative refs.
Inspect implementation/tests to confirm retry-era candidate grammar/state-machine helpers and generated delimiter/candidate arms-race matrices were removed rather than replaced.
Repeat the strict cursor-malleation probes from the FT-006 feature red-verify report.
